verdict.rationale: Stripe's webhooks docs mention a relink API for helping users reconnect an inactive account. That is a first-party repair flow, and it implies an inactive state is surfaced via webhooks. The evidence is one thin line, though: it gives no list of statuses (expired vs. revoked) and no detail on how relinking keeps the existing account instead of starting over. Missing for 10: a documented list of connection statuses and their transitions, specifics of the relink/update flow and what it preserves, and independent or hands-on corroboration that repair works.
